captions.detailed: A classical long achromatic refracting telescope mounted on an equatorial tripod. The telescope features a long, off-white cylindrical optical tube assembly with brass accent rings, a small finder scope mounted on top, and a dark grey eyepiece assembly at the rear. It is supported by a dark grey equatorial mount head with counterweights, which rests on a three-legged wooden tripod base with brass spreader bars. The mount features two rotational axes: a continuous right-ascension axis tilted toward the celestial pole and a perpendicular revolute declination axis for aiming the telescope.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a classical refractor telescope on a wooden equatorial mount. The model should include a three-legged wooden tripod base, a detailed dark grey equatorial mount head with counterweights, a continuous right-ascension axis, a revolute declination axis, and a long cream-colored telescope tube complete with brass mounting rings, a finder scope, and an eyepiece.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod legs and central column using extruded polygons, cylinders, and radial array transformations, applying a wood-colored material. Build the equatorial mount head using boolean combinations of dark grey boxes, cylinders, and a counterweight shaft with dual cylindrical weights. Model the main optical tube as a series of concentric cylinders (representing the main body, dew shield, and brass rings) and attach a smaller finder scope and eyepiece. Connect the assemblies using defined joints: a continuous joint for the right-ascension axis and a revolute joint for the declination axis to allow realistic articulation.
